import os,glob,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    G={}

        t=open(f).read().replace('\\n','\n')

            rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
            if all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
                G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

def f(g):
    H=len(g)
    out=[[0]*H for _ in range(H)]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(H):
            # find the value at position (i,j) by scanning column j in input: first row index p where g[p][j]==g[i][j] and p<=i, then look above for earlier same value... 
            # simpler: copy diagonal pattern; try direct copy approach: candidate = value that appears along column j at or below row i? Let's just search.
            col=[p for p in range(H) if g[p][j]==g[i][j]]
            if not col: continue
            best=max(col,key=lambda p: p)  # take bottom-most occurrence in column
            if best==i: out[i][j]=g[i][j]; continue

def solve(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0]); o=[r[:] for r in g]
    rs=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==2]
    rr0=min(r for r,c in rs); cc0=min(c for r,c in rs)
    rb=max(r for r,c in rs); cb=max(c for r,c in rs)
    cr=(rr0+rb)/2; cc=(cc0+cb)/2
    for r,c in [(R,C) for R,C in rs]:
        mR=int(round(cr-(r-cr))); mC=int(round(cc-(c-cc)))
        mR+=rr0; mC+=cc0
        if mR==r and mC==c: continue
        if 0<=mR<h and 0<=mC<w and g[mR][mC]!=2:
            o[r][c]=g[mR][mC]
    return o
